== anonymous: objects
GET https://storage.googleapis.com/storage/v1/b/bkt/o
  query alt=json
  query fields=kind%2CnextPageToken%2Cprefixes%2Citems%28name%2Csize%2Cupdated%2CtimeCreated%2Cetag%2Cgeneration%2Cmetageneration%2CstorageClass%2Cmd5Hash%2Ccrc32c%2CcontentType%29
  query prettyPrint=false
  query projection=noAcl
  header Accept-Encoding: gzip
  header User-Agent: <swath> <google-api-go-client>
  header X-Goog-Api-Client: gl-go/<version> gdcl/<version>
  body 0 bytes
== anonymous: objects, every option
GET https://storage.googleapis.com/storage/v1/b/bkt/o
  query alt=json
  query delimiter=%2F
  query endOffset=p%2Fe%26%3D%23%3F
  query fields=kind%2CnextPageToken%2Cprefixes%2Citems%28name%2Csize%2Cupdated%2CtimeCreated%2Cetag%2Cgeneration%2Cmetageneration%2CstorageClass%2Cmd5Hash%2Ccrc32c%2CcontentType%29
  query maxResults=1000
  query pageToken=tok%2F%2B%3D
  query prefix=p%2Fa+b%2Bc%25%2F%C3%A9
  query prettyPrint=false
  query projection=noAcl
  query startOffset=p%2Fa+b%2Bc%25%2F%C3%A9%00
  header Accept-Encoding: gzip
  header User-Agent: <swath> <google-api-go-client>
  header X-Goog-Api-Client: gl-go/<version> gdcl/<version>
  body 0 bytes
